verdict.rationale: Sentry's AI agent monitoring covers tracing, conversation replay, and LLM-call views for comparing models and prompts from recorded requests. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive playground for editing prompts and running them against live models with variables. Comparing logged LLM calls is an adjacent observability feature, not prompt iteration, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can iterate on prompts in a playground against real models and variables
